title: Symlinked toolchain precedes repository bin
summary: A two-hop symlink chain resolves Node to an unintended pre-existing fixture toolchain before the repository-local fixture bin.

proof_eligibility.reason: The planned case changes one typed dimension inside the supported Linux isolation backend.

oracle.description: The unchanged fixture assertion exits zero and emits the DEV-PATH-003 success marker.

scenario.failure_mode: Node resolution follows the first two-hop symlink chain to a fixture-marked incompatible launcher and exposes its canonical target path.
planned_setup: Pre-create incompatible and compatible launchers that forward to the same absolute Node executable and differ only in a fixed fixture marker.
Materialize the inventoried two-hop symlink recipe to the incompatible launcher inside a fresh writable fixture workspace.
Place the symlink directory before the repository fixture bin in A-like Host observation; prepend the repository fixture bin only in the planned B arm.
